description: This file is a shell script for installing the OpenClaw software on macOS and Linux systems. It includes functions for detecting system environment, managing temporary files, downloading files, installing build tools, and handling npm package installation. It also contains user interface functions for displaying progress and messages, as well as holiday-themed taglines and options for customizing the installation process.

methods.name: detect_downloader
methods.description: Detects whether 'curl' or 'wget' is available for downloading files.

methods.name: download_file
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL to a specified output path, using either curl or wget.

methods.name: run_remote_bash
methods.description: Downloads and executes a remote bash script from a URL.

methods.name: detect_os_or_die
methods.description: Detects the operating system (macOS or Linux) and exits if unsupported.

methods.name: ui_info
methods.description: Displays an informational message to the user.

methods.name: ui_warn
methods.description: Displays a warning message to the user.

methods.name: ui_success
methods.description: Displays a success message to the user.

methods.name: ui_error
methods.description: Displays an error message to the user.

methods.name: ui_section
methods.description: Displays a section header in the UI.

methods.name: ui_stage
methods.description: Displays a stage header in the UI.

methods.name: ui_kv
methods.description: Displays a key-value pair in the UI.

methods.name: ui_panel
methods.description: Displays a panel with content in the UI.

methods.name: show_install_plan
methods.description: Displays the planned installation steps and options.

methods.name: show_footer_links
methods.description: Displays footer links such as FAQ.

methods.name: ui_celebrate
methods.description: Displays a celebratory message.

methods.name: pick_tagline
methods.description: Selects a random or indexed tagline, including holiday taglines.

methods.name: append_holiday_taglines
methods.description: Appends holiday-specific taglines based on the current date.

methods.name: auto_install_build_tools_for_npm_failure
methods.description: Attempts to automatically install build tools if npm fails due to missing build dependencies.

methods.name: run_npm_global_install
methods.description: Runs npm to install a package globally, with logging and retry logic.

methods.name: install_build_tools_linux
methods.description: Automatically installs build tools on Linux distributions based on available package managers.

methods.name: install_build_tools_macos
methods.description: Installs build tools on macOS, including Xcode Command Line Tools and Homebrew packages.

methods.name: cleanup_legacy_submodules
methods.description: Removes legacy submodule directories.

methods.name: cleanup_npm_openclaw_paths
methods.description: Removes stale npm global openclaw directories.

methods.name: extract_openclaw_conflict_path
methods.description: Extracts file paths from error logs indicating file conflicts.

methods.name: cleanup_openclaw_bin_conflict
methods.description: Removes or backs up existing openclaw binaries or symlinks to resolve conflicts.

methods.name: npm_log_indicates_missing_build_tools
methods.description: Checks npm logs for errors indicating missing build tools.

methods.name: install_openclaw_npm
methods.description: Installs the openclaw npm package with error handling and retries.

methods.name: extract_openclaw_semver
methods.description: Extracts semantic version from raw version string, with fallback implementation.

methods.name: resolve_openclaw_version
methods.description: Determines the installed version of openclaw from binary or npm package.

methods.name: is_gateway_daemon_loaded
methods.description: Checks if the openclaw gateway daemon is loaded and active.

methods.name: refresh_gateway_service_if_loaded
methods.description: Refreshes and restarts the gateway service if it is loaded.

methods.name: verify_installation
methods.description: Verifies that openclaw and gateway service are correctly installed and running.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main installation flow handling argument parsing, environment setup, installation, post-installation checks, and user messaging.
